dct_description_sm:
Data set geolocating traffic signs regulating on-street parking.

Note that [road signs] (/city-of-montreal/traffic-signs) as well as other additional files that provide more details on sign codes are available in a separate set. 

The images and the visual catalog of all the panels are also available.

**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
